title: Quota is not regional capacity
briefing: A compute scale-out request failed during a traffic surge. Determine whether an account quota or regional capacity is the limiting condition. Every change is simulated.
learning_objective: Use the actual provider error and application constraints before choosing a quota increase or regional move.

evidence.text: Provisioning 20 new workers failed. Existing workers are healthy but queue age is increasing.
Synthetic provider response: InsufficientInstanceCapacity in region-a, zone-1. No account-limit error was returned.
Regional vCPU quota: 640 allowed, 320 used. Requested change needs 80 vCPUs. Quota headroom is 320.
Region-b has available workers and a tested traffic route. Replication lag is 25 seconds; data policy allows this region. The incident commander accepts a 60-second recovery point objective.

actions.label: Request an account quota increase
actions.outcome: Quota request recorded. This branch illustrates a supported observation leading to an ineffective mitigation.

effects.text: Quota increased in the simulation. Region-a zone-1 still returns InsufficientInstanceCapacity; queue age continues to rise.

actions.label: Shift 25% of traffic to region-b
actions.outcome: A bounded 25% simulated traffic shift was requested; recovery checks are still needed.

effects.text: Region-b serves the shifted 25%. Queue age falls, error rate returns below 1%, and replication lag stays below 30 seconds.

actions.label: Declare bounded mitigation successful
actions.outcome: Partial mitigation recorded. Remaining regional risk must be handed to the service owner.
